reason: In salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts, line 96 (`await prisma.credential.update`) is the only place `prisma` appears and the file never imports it. It type-checks only because of the `declare global var prisma` in packages/prisma/index.ts:6-9, and `globalThis.prisma` is set only when NODE_ENV !== 'production' (index.ts:58-60). In production, getClient therefore throws a ReferenceError and `this.conn` rejects.
